# Research brief: How map projections work

**Slug**: map-projections
**Status**: Approved
**Insight hash**: c4be86b23d92
**Updated**: 2026-11-05

## 1. Research mission
Investigate map projections from the sphere to the plane, with the conformal vs equal-area trade-off and choosing a projection for a given map as the centre.

## 2. Research methodology and source policy
Tier 1 textbooks, USGS publications and papers; tier 2 PROJ documentation; verification standard.

## 3. Curriculum modules

### M01 — From the globe to the plane
Level 1 · Group: Foundations. Topics: the sphere · latitude and longitude · developable surfaces.
Priority: no

### M02 — Mercator and conformal projections
Level 1 · Group: Foundations. Topics: conformality · scale factor · rhumb lines.

### M03 — Equal-area projections
Level 2 · Group: Core. Topics: Lambert cylindrical · Mollweide · Equal Earth.

### M04 — Compromise projections and Tissot's indicatrix  (Level 2 · Group: Core)
Priority: yes

### M05 — Choosing a projection for a map
Level 2 · Group: Core.

### M06 — Inside Web Mercator tile servers
Level 3 · Group: Advanced.

## 4. Integrated project

### S01 — Project: my own world map
Stages 1–3.
